properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Deployment automation (net/ scripts) invokes ssh with StrictHostKeyChecking=no and UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null — host-key verification disabled on all 8 sites (judged individually). Real MITM exposure in ops tooling.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha1 crate in Cargo.lock — transitive dependency; no direct workspace source use found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: libsecp256k1 (0.6.0) providing the on-chain secp256k1 precompile program (secp256k1_program::id()) for ECDSA secp256k1 signature verification in transactions; cost-model constants price the verify. Shor-vulnerable (migration ML-DSA-65). Samples uniform.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Sampled 15 of 70 sites across accounts-db, bench-tps, cli, cli-output, gossip, ledger, shred: all are ==/!= comparisons of PUBLIC values (account/block hashes, Signature sentinels, shred signatures for dedup) — no secret or MAC material compared, so the CWE-208 timing concern does not apply at sampled sites. Kept as recorded comparisons of crypto-typed values; uninteresting by design.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Object mis-classified by name: 'siv' in the aes-gcm-siv crate name collided with 'static IV'. Real asset is the aes-gcm-siv AEAD dependency (AES-128-GCM-SIV, used by zk-token-sdk auth_encryption); the gce-self-destruct.sh site (div variable) was rejected as a false match.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge ^1 (RSA/X.509/TLS implementations) in the docs website toolchain lockfile — not shipped validator code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Solana's core signature scheme: ed25519-dalek =1.0.1 (+ ed25519-dalek-bip32 for hierarchical key derivation) declared workspace-wide; live usage across sigverify (perf/ledger), keypair generation, transaction signatures, QUIC identity certs. Shor-vulnerable (migration ML-DSA-65/SLH-DSA). Samples uniform across 40 files; remaining sites are the same dependency/usage pattern.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: curve25519-dalek 3.2.1 PATCHED to the solana-labs fork via [patch.crates-io] (Cargo.toml:543-544) — a governance-relevant vendored-fork decision. Used for Ed25519 batch verification (perf/src/sigverify.rs Edwards/Scalar) and the zk-token-sdk's Curve25519 ElGamal/Pedersen cryptography. Shor-vulnerable (migration ML-KEM-768 for KX/agreement uses).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA assets in this repo: ssh-keygen -t ecdsa for the CI agent (ci/setup-new-buildkite-agent) and the committed P-256 authorized_keys. The two ledger/src/sigverify_shreds.rs sites rejected at site level remain false matches (debug log strings; actual verification is Ed25519).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed ECDSA P-256 SSH public keys distributed to all testnet/datacenter nodes via net/scripts/solana-user-authorized_keys.sh. Key material is public-key-only; the curve and algorithm are quantum-vulnerable (Shor).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 resolved in Cargo.lock — the locked implementation version backing all signature operations.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CI bootstrap curls (rustup install) pinning minimum TLS 1.2; not a service endpoint, one-shot downloads in docker/buildkite setup. Quantum-vulnerable KX only in the sense that all deployed TLS is.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Curve25519 resolved in Cargo.lock (curve25519-dalek chain) — the locked group-arithmetic implementation.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 resolved in Cargo.lock — the locked key-exchange implementation (rustls/ring path and dalek).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 (pre-NIST-padding SHA-3 variant) exposed as the sol_keccak256 BPF syscall (programs/bpf_loader/src/syscalls/mod.rs:201-317, keccak::Hasher), plus SHA-3-512 key derivation in zk-token-sdk auth encryption and the C implementation in programs/sbf. Hashes are Grover-weakened only; not Shor-relevant, but part of the shipped crypto surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE3 used for account-state hashing (accounts_db.rs:5908 Hasher::new, blake3::hash of pubkeys, accounts_hash.rs) and declared across workspace crates. Not Shor-relevant; Grover-weakened only. Real shipped hash.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: zk-keygen CLI generates AES-128 keys (KeyType::Aes128) for SPL token-2022 confidential transfers; keys derived from BIP39 seed phrase and written to file. AES-128 gives only 64-bit PQ security margin under Grover.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 with 2048 rounds / 64-byte output deriving the wallet seed from a BIP39 mnemonic in solana-sdk keypair (sdk/src/signer/keypair.rs:246-255). 2048 iterations is the BIP39 standard but far below OWASP password-KDF minimums; entropy comes from the 12/24-word mnemonic rather than a password.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128-GCM-SIV AEAD (misuse-resistant) wrapping encrypt/decrypt of u64 amounts for SPL token-2022 confidential balances; keys from zk-keygen; constant-time comparison and zeroize used alongside.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHAKE-256 XOF deriving the deterministic Pedersen commitment generators for the Bulletproofs-style range proofs in the zk-token-sdk (standard generator derivation).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC resolved in Cargo.lock (hmac crate) — the MAC behind PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 seed derivation; no standalone HMAC tag verification found in source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES implementation available in the docs website toolchain lockfile (node-forge chain) — tooling only, not shipped code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 (256-bit) resolved in Cargo.lock — locked implementation backing sdk/program/src/hash.rs core Hash (blockhash/Pubkey/PoH) and the sol_sha256 syscall.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE3-256 resolved in Cargo.lock — locked implementation behind accounts-db hash sites.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: rand::rngs::OsRng supplies randomness for ElGamal blinding, range proofs and sigma proofs in zk-token-sdk (elgamal.rs:49, inner_product.rs:426, mod.rs:17, sigma_proofs). OsRng is the OS CSPRNG — secure source. ledger/blockstore.rs:4373 rand_bytes(0) is a zero-length call (no-op).
